sentences.original_text: In an earlier lesson we talked about ways to say goodbye.
sentences.translated_text: 在之前的課程中，我們談過說再見的方法。

sentences.original_text: We only had time for the formal ways, like “Goodbye” and “Have a good day.”
sentences.translated_text: 當時只來得及介紹正式的說法，像是「Goodbye」和「Have a good day」。

sentences.original_text: Today, we want to teach some informal ways to part from a friend.
sentences.translated_text: 今天我們想教一些和朋友道別時的非正式說法。

sentences.original_text: If you think you will see them soon, you might say, “See you soon” or “See ya’ soon.”
sentences.translated_text: 如果你覺得很快會再見到對方，可以說「See you soon」或「See ya' soon」。

sentences.original_text: When we speak informally, we often use the reduced vowel, or schwa, which sounds like “uh.”
sentences.translated_text: 用非正式語氣說話時，我們常用弱化母音，也就是 schwa，聽起來像「uh」。

sentences.original_text: In writing, you might see this written with “ya” as in “See ya later” or “See ya’ around!”
sentences.translated_text: 書寫時你可能會看到寫成「ya」，例如「See ya later」或「See ya' around!」。

sentences.original_text: The structure for these expressions is verb, with an optional preposition, plus “you” plus time.
sentences.translated_text: 這些說法的結構是：動詞（可加介系詞）＋ you ＋ 時間。

sentences.original_text: For example: See you later.
sentences.translated_text: 例如：See you later（待會見）。

sentences.original_text: One example with a preposition is, “Talk to you later.”
sentences.translated_text: 加上介系詞的一個例子是「Talk to you later（晚點再聊）」。

sentences.original_text: So we might say, “see you tomorrow” or “catch you next week.”
sentences.translated_text: 所以我們可以說「see you tomorrow（明天見）」或「catch you next week（下週見）」。

sentences.original_text: Sometimes we just use “until” with “later” or another time word.
sentences.translated_text: 有時我們只用「until」加上「later」或其他時間詞。

sentences.original_text: For example, “Until tomorrow.”
sentences.translated_text: 例如「Until tomorrow（明天見）」。

sentences.original_text: I’ve heard people just say, “later.”
sentences.translated_text: 我也聽過有人只說「later（回頭見）」。

sentences.original_text: And sometimes we are saying goodbye to someone we don’t expect to see again soon.
sentences.translated_text: 有時候我們道別的對象，是短期內不會再見面的人。

sentences.original_text: In that case, we wish them well.
sentences.translated_text: 這種時候，我們會給對方祝福。

sentences.original_text: At the goodbye party for Mary, I heard some of those.
sentences.translated_text: 在 Mary 的歡送會上，我聽到了一些這樣的說法。

sentences.original_text: One was “Take care of yourself and stay in touch.”
sentences.translated_text: 其中一句是「Take care of yourself and stay in touch（保重，保持聯絡）」。

sentences.original_text: Right. If someone is leaving on a trip, you can wish them a safe journey, with “Have a safe trip!”
sentences.translated_text: 沒錯。如果有人要出門旅行，你可以說「Have a safe trip!」祝對方一路平安。

sentences.original_text: Or we can say, “Drive safely.”
sentences.translated_text: 或者可以說「Drive safely（開車小心）」。

sentences.original_text: Well. I have to go now, John.
sentences.translated_text: 好啦，John，我得走了。

sentences.original_text: As our friend Anna says, “Until next time!”
sentences.translated_text: 就像我們的朋友 Anna 常說的：「Until next time!（下次見！）」

sentences.original_text: Later, Jill! And that’s Everyday Grammar!
sentences.translated_text: 回頭見，Jill！以上就是 Everyday Grammar！
